messages:
liam: Heads up — embeddings service is returning 502s for short sequences since ~09:05 UTC. Error rate spiking to 8% on prod-eu1. Rolling back previous image seems to fix locally. Need expedited hotfix deploy & approvals. Can @marta (release lead) or @sachin (on-call infra) ack?

deploybot: :robot_face: New deploy request received. Service: embeddings, Current image: rwd/embeds:v2.1.3, Proposed image: rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix. Canary by default set to 10%. Run `/deploy start embeddings --image rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix --canary 0.1 --reason "502 on short seq"` to proceed.

liam: Notes: root cause is an attn kernel edge for short sequences; compiled fallback fixes. Patch includes a single-line guard in kv-cache ctor. Rollback criteria: if error rate >3% over 2m or tail latency > 2s p95. Rollback actions: roll to rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-rollback(sha) and drain canary.

marta: reading. Can we skip full canary and do 0% -> 100%? customers hit in eu. What are risk & testing summary?

liam: risk low — change is tiny; perf tests on staging show no sensitivity. We prefer 10% quick canary for 5m then 50% for 10m then full. But if we need speed we can do instant pin to full with a manual rollback gate.

sachin: on-call here. I can approve expedited. I want telemetry alerts firing to #incidents and automated rollback if threshold crossed. ops-bot, can you wire the alert?

ops-bot: @sachin Alert hook created: incidents channel + pager. Threshold: error_rate > 3% over 120s OR p95_latency > 2s. Auto-rollback enabled: yes.

emily: quick QA: smoke-tested the hotfix image on eu staging. No regressions for short seq or long seq. LGTM.

marta: ok, I'm approving but we keep the canary timed window. Approve from me. :thumbsup:

sachin: approve. :white_check_mark:

liam: running deploy now. command: ```/deploy start embeddings --image rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix --canary 0.1 --steps "5m@10%,10m@50%,manual@100%" --reason "502 on short seq"```

deploybot: :rocket: Deploy started by liam. Stage 1: canary 10% in prod-eu1. Job id: db-1751119999-01. Logs: ```[09:12:01] pulling image rwd/embeds:v2.1.3-hotfix
[09:12:12] starting 4 pods
[09:12:35] healthchecks passing```

liam: monitoring metrics — error rate down to 0.5% in canary. p95 stable.

sachin: good. keeping pager on. If anything at all odd, I will trigger rollback.

emily: prepping release note snippet and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/1823 — includes changelog and CVE note (none).

releasebot: Release PR detected: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/pull/1823 (auto-link). Draft release note added: "embeddings: fix 502 on short sequences — v2.1.3-hotfix"

deploybot: Stage 1 complete. Promoting to 50% (10m window). Stage 2 job id: db-1751119999-02.

liam: 50% stable after 6m. No anomalies.

marta: proceed to full when stage completes. I will be on-call for handover.

deploybot: Stage 2 complete. Waiting manual approval for 100% (manual@100%).

liam: manual go from me. Executing promote: `/deploy promote db-1751119999-02 --to 100`

deploybot: :tada: Deploy promoted to 100% across prod. Final job id: db-1751119999-03. Healthchecks green.

ops-bot: Final telemetry snapshot: error rate back to baseline 0.1%, p95 latency unchanged. No rollback triggered.

sachin: marking incident mitigated. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours.

emily: release note published and tagged in changelog. Pushing release pipeline to prod docs.

marta: thumbs up on communication. Quick retrospective item: add a tiny integration test for short seq path. Filed as https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/412

liam: thanks all. closing thread but keeping eyes open. If anything pops, re-open this thread or ping me. :eyes:
